thread:
micah: Kicking off v3.15.1 rollout to green. Rolling weights: 5% -> 15% -> 35% -> 70% -> 100%. Will run EU canary then US. tagging @router-oncall and @engops.

release-bot: New release created: v3.15.1. Notes: improved batching, minor model config tweak. PR: #4900.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan registered. Wait between steps: 4m. Abort conditions: p95 > baseline * 2 OR error-rate delta > +4% over 5m. Auto-rollback enabled.

sophie: Two quick asks: 1) pin model-variant=stable for blue during drain, 2) set lb_cookie_mode=preserve to reduce reauth churn.

omar: Agreed. Pre-staging commands:```routerctl set-weight service-x green 5 && routerctl set-cookie-mode preserve``` and ```configctl pin model service-x blue variant=stable --ttl=3600```. I'll stage the pin.

lena: Heads-up: cert-rotation job is scheduled at 01:00 UTC. If we do final 100% around that time we might see short TLS renegotiation blips. Recommend finish ramp to 70% now and wait for confirmation after 01:20 UTC.

micah: Good call. We'll plan to stop at 70% and resume after cert rotation. Leave pre-staged override to go to blue if needed.

router-oncall: Preflight checks: EU canary endpoints healthy. probe eu-west1: 200 OK, p95=48ms (blue p95=45ms). No errors.

deploy-bot: Applying batch 1 -> 5% (eu-west canary). Monitoring at /dash/releases/3180105555.

micah: Batch1 stable for 4m. p95 +3%, errors flat. Proceeding to 15%.

deploy-bot: Batch 2 -> 15% applied globally.

router-oncall: Observed slight increase in auth latency in eu-west (p95 +12ms). Might be cache warm. Watching.

sophie: Reminder to warm the KV cache on green to avoid auth spikes. command: `kcctl warm --service service-x --region eu-west1 --target=green`

omar: Kicking KV warm. Also confirming model pin is active on blue for sticky sessions.

deploy-bot: Batch 3 -> 35% rolled. Monitoring 10m. Alert thresholds armed.

lena: infra note: post-deploy job (logs-indexer) will hit ingestion around 01:10 UTC. That overlaps cert rotation slightly. Avoid final cutover before ingestion completes.

micah: Ok stopping at 70% then pause. We'll resume after cert rotation + ingestion clear. Anyone object?

deploy-bot: Batch 4 -> 70% applied. Rollout paused per request. Auto-rollback still armed.

release-bot: Short release-note draft posted to PR #4900: includes note about LB cookie change and session pinning. CS wants the bullet about expected 1-2 minute auth blips during warmup.

engops: I'll confirm cert-rotation done and logs-indexer finished. Will post in 15m.

sophie: For fast rollback, pre-made override API call (saved in playbook):```curl -XPOST https://router-api.internal/overrides -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"service":"service-x","force_route":"blue","reason":"rollback-3180105555"}'```

omar: That override is staged but locked behind a 2-step manual ack. If we want auto-apply on severe errors, we can flip to single-ack. Recommend keep manual for now.

micah: Keep manual. We want a human in the loop for this one.

engops: cert rotation completed at 01:03 UTC. logs-indexer done at 01:12 UTC. Ready to resume if no objections.

micah: Resuming. Small smoke at 85% for 3m, then 100% if green.

deploy-bot: Batch resume: 85% applied. Monitoring short smoke.

router-oncall: No TLS renegotiation spikes observed. p95 stable, error-rate normal.

micah: Proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: Final batch -> 100% applied. Rolling pin resets: unset cookie-preserve after 30m of stability.

lena: Post-cutover checks: confirm sticky sessions, KV cache warm, metrics flowing to ingestion.

sophie: All checks green from my side. KV warm completed.

omar: Model-variant pin on blue will expire in 50m automatically; removing earlier could create churn.

micah: Great work. I'll finalize release notes and close PR #4900. Katie, can you broadcast to #general?

release-bot: Release v3.15.1 marked successful. Notes: traffic shift completed; minor auth warmup observed; no rollback.

micah: Thanks team. Thread closed unless we see regressions.
